name: VSN F-16 Fighting Falcon
summary: VSN team's free FC3-style F-16 family (F-16A, MLU, Block 50/52) for DCS World.
description:
Free VSN F-16 pack with several variants (F-16A, F-16AM MLU, Block 50, Block 52 with Su-25T avionics), custom exterior model and FC3-style cockpit. Flyable with the FC3 (F-15C/Su-27-style) cockpit, or as AI without FC3.

VSN's downloads are on pCloud and ask for a password; VSN publishes it on their download index: `VSNROX`.

Requires: Flyable only with Flaming Cliffs 3 installed; otherwise usable as AI.
license: Free, private use only, commercial use prohibited (VSN terms)
